decision: Kept GDRIVE_INVOICING_MAC = None in gdrive_upload.py: tests/test_drive_sync.py patches it with raising=True, so removing it fails the acceptance test; brief says tests are not editable

Plan authoring labelled 'the server has the new numbering code' baseline_expect: fail, but it depends on next-number-from-drive plus Metis's minute-level auto-pull of origin/main, so it passed at the stage baseline and the controller halted with EXPECTATION MISMATCH. Attended fix: relabelled it baseline_expect: pass, re-ran all 3 clauses green, marked the stage done by hand instead of resetting to pending (a re-spawn would hit the same mismatch on clauses 2 and 3).
learning: A clause that checks a deploy target which auto-pulls main is satisfied by any earlier stage that pushes; author it as a guard (pass), not fail-first.
